snippet.title: Morvex | Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Morvex is a fast-paced round-based zombie survival game where you fight waves of enemies, upgrade your weapons, survive boss fights, and push for the highest round.

Wishlist Morvex on Steam and join our Discord for updates, news, and community discussions.
